name: fresh
description: One-shot sample of first-party C/C++ sources from public repositories not used to develop the grammar before release 0.1.0; selection was fixed before the first parse. Its 0.1.0 failures later guided standard-syntax fixes, so it is no longer a blind sample.
selection: Per repository, C/C++ source and header files excluding vendored, third-party and generated files; up to 100 files chosen by SHA-256 of the repository-relative path.
